description: This file contains Polymer framework features, including template preparation, DOM manipulation, custom element registration, and shadow DOM handling, primarily for Polymer mini.html component.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: Provides DOM manipulation and observation APIs, including node insertion, removal, cloning, and event handling, with support for Shadow DOM and Shady DOM.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: Wrapper for classList property, allowing class manipulation with automatic parent distribution updates.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observes effective DOM nodes, including content and distributed nodes, with support for Shadow DOM mutation observation.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for distributed nodes in Shadow DOM, extending EffectiveNodesObserver.

classes.name: Polymer.EventApi
classes.description: Provides a wrapper around DOM events to normalize event properties across Shadow DOM boundaries.

methods.name: Polymer.dom
methods.description: Factory function to obtain a DOM API wrapper for a node or event.

methods.name: Polymer.domInnerHTML.getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML of a node, with proper escaping.

methods.name: Polymer.Base._addFeature
methods.description: Registers features and behaviors into the Polymer framework.
